text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Well then, shall we start the meeting?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is right around the 
corner. I cannot afford to waste a single 
moment, so...
Ho, ho, ho! Merryyyy Chriiiistmaaaas!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Grass, Grass's Trainer, good eveee-ning♪ 
Are you having fuuun~!?

The one who burst in vigorously was Taiki 
Shuttle— Grass Wonder's senior at the Miho 
dorm and a fellow American-born Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
T-Taiki-senpai? What's the matter, all of 
a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Oh!? No, this is terrible, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Both of you, please help me right now!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh? Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Right, Grass gets this mall! Grass's 
Trainer is my support!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Non, non! Put it somewhere more 
eye-catching, pleeease! Make it go 
kablam!!

And just when I thought I was roped into 
helping without knowing why...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah... In the blink of an eye, the 
trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Peeeerfeeeect!! Thank you, both of you♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Grass, you must not forget Christmas! 
Where is your Kentucky spirit!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, I wasn't born in Kentucky...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fired up and burning with spirit for the 
Arima Kinen! I know that feeling all too 
well, it's scorching hot, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
BUUUT! Taking a breather is necessary, 
YES! Otherwise you will burn to a crisp, 
YES!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Taiki-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's about time for Taiki Santa to 
head back to the sleigh.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And with that! Good ni~ght♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha...! This room has really turned 
into something incredible...!
choice_data_list:
...Guess a meeting is impossible like 
this!

...Guess having a meeting like this is out 
of the question!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Yes, indeed.

"...Since the opportunity had presented 
itself, I decided to enjoy Christmas to 
the fullest with Grass Wonder."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A whole box of chicken... Fufufu. While 
it's a bit different from a Christmas 
dinner back home, this is quite nice too.
choice_data_list:
Let's head home and eat before it gets 
cold!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still... The illuminations are so 
beautiful, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, the Christmas 
illuminations looked just like real stars 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Stars that are usually out of reach will 
descend to the earth on this one special 
day... or so they say."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I even thought that being able to touch a 
star shining in the sky was a Christmas 
miracle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was back when I was really 
little, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right now... no matter how distant and 
towering they may be, I feel that I don't 
need a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because I will keep climbing higher and 
higher, on my own two legs.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Even high enough to touch the stars.
choice_data_list: I know you can get there!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Hearing you say that is the best 
Christmas present I've gotten all year~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will cherish this. ...So that I may 
grasp my star.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Still, after climbing so high that your 
hands can reach the stars, it's pretty 
tough coming back down, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There must be clear markers on the ground. 
If someone were to crash, it would be a 
terrible disaster.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, can I count on you when that 
time comes?"
choice_data_list: I'm gonna wave my hands as hard as I can!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufufu! ...My, how charming.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be counting on you when the time 
comes, Trainer."
